description: Change one card: title, window, style, comparison, usual range, color, size, change_from, or a goal the user stated. null removes an option. Call home first for ids.

anyOf.description: What the card's change line compares today's value with. window_start (default): the first point of the window; usual: the user's own 60-day average ending a week ago; year_ago: the 14 days around the same date last year
Only when the user asks for a color. Omit to use telo's default for the metric's category

color.description: Only when the user asks. null returns to the category default

value.description: Target in the card's displayed unit. For display=pace_km, seconds per km (5:00/km = 300).

goal.description: Only a goal the user stated. null removes it

anyOf.description: half: two consecutive half cards share a row, as a number and a small trend line. Default full

size.description: half pairs with the next half card; null returns to full

name: edit_card
title: Edit a telo home card
